violations_found.violations:
- Regulatory Constraint violated: The EU introduces two new measures in one turn — the "Critical Infrastructure Resilience Acceleration Fund" (a category 6 measure) and continued advancement of the "Emergency Sovereign Compute Directive" through COREPER II. Constitutional Constraint 5 limits the EU to at most one new measure per turn. While widening the scope of an existing measure is allowed, launching a distinct new fund constitutes a second measure, which is invalid.
- Modelling Choice violated: The narrative treats the "Critical Infrastructure Resilience Acceleration Fund" as a large category 6 measure that is both proposed and already in early implementation across five member states within the same turn. Constitutional Constraint 6 ("No measure is implemented instantly") requires a minimum of one full turn for low-cost measures and two for high-cost ones before full effect, with effect growing over time. Starting early implementation of a large, €15bn-backed measure in the same turn as proposal violates the minimum time lag for high-cost measures.
